question: Zambia nearest 5 countries distance km
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name = 'Zambia') SELECT c.name, ST_Distance_Sphere(target.geometry, c.geometry)/1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c, target WHERE c.name != 'Zambia' ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(target.geometry, c.geometry) LIMIT 5

question: Germany 500km radius nearby countries
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name = 'Germany') SELECT c.name, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, target.geometry)/1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c CROSS JOIN target WHERE c.name != 'Germany' AND ST_DWithin(c.geometry, target.geometry, 500000, use_spheroid := true) ORDER BY dist_km

question: Vatican closest river distance km
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name = 'Vatican') SELECT r.name, r.feature_class, ST_Distance_Sphere(target.geometry, r.geometry)/1000 AS dist_km FROM rivers r CROSS JOIN target WHERE r.geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(target.geometry, r.geometry) LIMIT 1

question: South America each country nearest river distance
sql: SELECT c.name AS country, n.river_name, n.dist_km FROM countries c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.name AS river_name, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r.geometry)/1000 AS dist_km FROM rivers r WHERE r.geometry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r.geometry) LIMIT 1) n WHERE c.continent = 'South America' ORDER BY c.name

question: Europe closest country pair gap km
sql: SELECT c1.name AS country_a, c2.name AS country_b, ST_Distance_Sphere(c1.geometry, c2.geometry)/1000 AS gap_km FROM countries c1 JOIN countries c2 ON c1.name < c2.name WHERE c1.continent = 'Europe' AND c2.continent = 'Europe' AND ST_Distance_Sphere(c1.geometry, c2.geometry) > 0 ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(c1.geometry, c2.geometry) LIMIT 1

question: rivers within 200km Zambia border
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name = 'Zambia') SELECT r.name, r.feature_class, ST_Distance_Sphere(r.geometry, target.geometry)/1000 AS dist_km FROM rivers r CROSS JOIN target WHERE r.geometry IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry, target.geometry, 200000, use_spheroid := true) ORDER BY dist_km
